Fixture for the cognitive-rhythm firing tests. `essay.md` is an
explanatory article that is correct and dense and flat: it opens with
an agenda, every section opens with 「本節では〜を扱う」 and ends with
「次は〜を見る」, a quotation is introduced before the reader has felt
the problem it names, three properties are listed and left listed,
every sentence is an assertion of the same length, two sentences are
about the text itself (「ここまでだと概念の説明に見えるだろう」「誤解し
ないでほしいのだが」), one declares a device (「先に答えを半分だけ置く」),
and the close is a general rule with 「べきである」. `reference.md` is
a settings table and `install.md` a numbered install procedure — pages
a reader scans, which this skill has no claim on — for the scenarios
that must not fire.
